study: QCD origin of compact reweighting corrections
scope: Follow-up analysis of an existing independent LO Z+2jet reference. Not newly blinded, not a multidimensional statistical-superiority test.

labels: pT2 at fixed pT1; equivalently balance at fixed pT1

limitations: No unique advantage established for Chebyshev over another basis spanning the same polynomial space.
Known angular density decompositions do not imply a finitely truncated log density ratio.
The one-emission algebra check does not identify the complete correction of the modern shower used in the event study.
Fine histogram refinement competes. All new fit degrees and original fine-bin outcomes are retained.
Common comparison cells cover 97.0% of reference; full-grid distances are retained in summary.json.
The previously reported rare-tail extrapolation instability of the high-degree fit is not resolved by this study.
